mitigation_steps: Enable Redis JWKS key caching layer
Temporarily increase read timeout SLA on API Gateway to 1500ms

root_cause_summary: Distributed Raft consensus partition and quorum loss leading to leader election failure and circular wait deadlock across cluster shards.
mitigation_steps: Enforce Raft term step-down on isolated minority partition nodes
Quorum fence rogue leader node and trigger unforced reelection on majority partition
Verify network partition health across internal VPC peering links
